verdict.rationale: Fellow's developer docs include a dedicated webhooks reference. Fellow sends an HTTP POST to a URL you specify when events occur, such as an AI note being generated or an action item being completed. This gives real-time notifications without polling, which meets the core of the story. missing for 10: a documented full event catalog, the registration method (UI vs. API), payload signing/verification and retry semantics, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
